name: The Suffering: Ties That Bind
description: The Suffering: Ties That Bind is a singleplayer first- and third-person shooter and survival horror game and the second in The Suffering series.

gog.store_details: Delisted from GOG on 1 September 2024 at Warner Bros.' request; GOG was the only storefront that carried it.

notes: The Vogons Wiki confirms an 'Enable EAX' option in the game's configuration utility but doesn't record which EAX version(s) it covers.
